s: Sharded ordered event streams with multi-day replay - AWS's log-as-a-service for telemetry pipelines.
w: Streams divide capacity into shards (1MB/s-in, 2MB/s-out each); partition keys route records deterministically preserving per-key order. Consumers read shards directly or via enhanced fan-out (dedicated throughput). Records persist 24h-365d enabling reprocessing. Data Streams vs Firehose (auto-deliver to S3/redshift) distinction matters.
use: Clickstream/app-event ingestion feeding analytics + ML features
CDC transport from databases to processors
avoid: Unbounded hot partition keys - shard storms

props.partition_key: Deterministic shard routing key preserving order

pat.d: Speed layer (flink) + batch replay (spark) from same stream.

pits: Iterator-age alarms ignored -> silent lag growth - monitor consumer lag religiously
Hot shards on celebrity keys - salting strategies
tips: Replay capability is the headline differentiator vs queues - say why (bug fixes, backfills, new consumers)
